scope: Actual generated nested bootstrap validate_fields with two synchronous 512-bit Message read ports, a 16-bit purpose input and an 8-bit content input. Fifteen separate reset-initialized processes observe actual start/done/return: legal purpose1/content1, three bad purpose scalars (0/2/0x0101), three bad content scalars (0/2/255), content1 with an independently corrupted target_region, and seven single-byte corruptions at model offsets0/64/128/192/256/320/384. The 12-word controlled Message comes from immutable diagnostic03; every semantic byte is checked against the independent literal owner, and only its 49 ABI padding bytes with unknown bits are resolved to zero, preserving all known bits and saving the unknown mask. This proves only the isolated validator interface, not an owner-installation rejection, endpoint wire behavior, caller dynamic mapping, runtime/executor/service ownership, X-padding invariance, full graph, retirement, OOC, physical timing or board behavior.
